title: Super Splashes
body:
# Super Splashes – Resource Pack

Super Splashes adds a bunch of custom splash texts with a nostalgic feel, mixed with fun references and inside jokes. A lot of them are inspired by minecraft legends and moments everyone knows about. 

It doesn’t change anything big, it just makes the title screen more interesting and a bit funnier every time you load in.

Simple, lightweight, and made for people who like old vibes with dumb _(in a good way)_ jokes.
